Edge of Memories | Nekaroo Gameplay sPAWtlight
Happy Caturday!

We're celebrating International Cat Day by highlighting your furry companion in Edge of Memories. Explore these gorgeous anime-inspired vistas on the back of your Nekaroo.

Interacting with pillars scattered throughout the environment will unlock Nekaroo exploration, revealing new paths and areas for you to discover. 

Edge of Memories is an action-RPG created by a small French team with a love for JRPGs, old-school action games, and kitties.

Edge of Memories will be available on XBOX Series X|S later this year.

REANIMAL | The Prisoner DLC Release Trailer
Tarsier Studios are back with a new chapter in the dread-filled co-op horror adventure game REANIMAL.

This DLC features two brand new characters: The Soldier and the Prisoner! They must survive the war-ravaged streets of a once-familiar place, stumbling blindly down a rabbit hole that will change their lives forever. Explore previously unseen areas of the world of REANIMAL, on foot and otherwise, and discover that while war can be hell, some experiences are even worse.
